limitations: Flags every conversion; a constant literal argument would be a false positive.

provenance.writtenFor: Ultimate Master Pump synthetic evaluation breadth (2026-10-19)

purpose: A request parameter becomes an atom, which permanently grows the atom table (CWE-400 shape).

groundTruth.rationale: String.to_atom on request data creates one atom per distinct input; the BEAM atom table is not garbage collected, so repeated traffic exhausts the VM.
